name: io.github.verygoodplugins/mcp-pirsch
title: MCP Pirsch
description: Read-only Pirsch Analytics API v1 queries, safe domain discovery, and period comparisons.

environmentVariables.name: PIRSCH_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Pirsch OAuth API client ID with read access

environmentVariables.name: PIRSCH_DEFAULT_DOMAIN_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional default domain ID; queries otherwise require domainId

environmentVariables.name: PIRSCH_TIMEZONE
environmentVariables.description: Optional IANA timezone used when a request omits timezone

tools.name: pirsch_list_domains
tools.description: List safe summaries of accessible Pirsch domains

tools.name: pirsch_query_statistics
tools.description: Query one documented Pirsch Analytics API v1 metric

tools.name: pirsch_list_filter_options
tools.description: List allowed values for a Pirsch filter dimension

tools.name: pirsch_compare_periods
tools.description: Compare totals and visitor series across two periods
